description: This file defines the CookieJarInterface, an interface specifying methods for storing, managing, and retrieving HTTP cookies within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It includes method signatures for adding cookies to requests, extracting cookies from responses, and managing stored cookies.

classes.name: CookieJarInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for cookie storage implementations, including methods for managing cookies in HTTP requests and responses, clearing cookies, converting to array, and supporting iteration and counting.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Creates and returns a new request object with the appropriate Cookie header added based on stored cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from an HTTP response and stores them internally in the cookie jar.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Sets a specific cookie in the jar; returns success status.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies from the jar based on optional domain, path, and name filters.

methods.name: clearSessionCookies
methods.description: Removes all session cookies that do not have an expiration or discard flag.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the cookie jar contents to an array representation.
